text: The text contains sarcasm in the first two sentences. The speaker claims to "love" when their phone dies during an important call and calls it the "best feature of modern technology." Since phone battery failure during critical moments is universally frustrating and undesirable, the positive language is used ironically to express strong annoyance and dissatisfaction. This sarcasm flips the apparent positive sentiment of the words "love" and "best" into a strongly negative sentiment regarding the user's experience. The final sentence is a neutral factual question and does not contribute to the sarcastic tone.
